relationships.evidence_quote: We found that HB venom strongly activated the skin from these KO mice.

key_findings: Honeybee and wasp venoms activate mouse skin nociceptive C-fibers, more strongly the chloroquine-sensitive subtype, mimicked by melittin but not apamin.
Venom C-fiber activation was not significantly blocked by TRPV1/TRPA1 antagonists, and venom mast cell activation was independent of MrgprB2.
